acceptance: TPC-DS delimited output is SHA-256 identical to bundled dsdgen for all 24 tables at SF 0.01 and 0.1.
TPC-H RF1/RF2 and TPC-DS -update output is byte-identical to the C binaries at SF 0.01 and 1.
PR parity CI covers TPC-DS SF 0.01, 0.1 and 1.0 and the refresh sets.
description:
Coverage the upstream crates lack (docs/internal/adr/adr-benchbox-datagen.md (revised 2026-11-26, PR #4540), decision 1). TPC-DS SF < 1 must follow BenchBox's patched dsdgen scaling curve; TPC-H RF1/RF2 and TPC-DS -update must match the C binaries. Prefer contributing upstream when the change fits upstream; otherwise implement in benchbox-datagen-core on top of the upstream crates without forking them.

Decision gate: if byte identity at SF < 1 needs a change upstream will not accept and that cannot live outside the crates, stop and ask the owner.

Guardrails: no fork of tpcgen-rs; no auto backend mode or silent fallback; Python stays the only manifest writer; heavy measurements only through make heavy-run with N=3 medians recorded in the PR body; budgets from the ADR table are the gate, and a miss goes to the owner rather than being waived.
